item.title: Real-time Asset Budgets

learningObjectives.item: Explain how real-time rendering differs from offline rendering
Estimate polygon and texture budgets for an asset
Apply consistent texel density across a set of assets
Reduce draw calls with shared materials and texture atlases

item.content: How game engines render your work, and the budgets that follow from it: polygon counts, texel density, draw calls and texture memory.
